question: Do annotated internal protein deletions remove at least one quarter of a UniProt domain and have locus-specific junction-peptide support from independent proteomics projects?
status: Analyst-defined before candidate screening and peptide-level inspection; not a registered preregistration
discovery_inputs: UniProt reviewed Arabidopsis canonical sequences and DOMAIN features

discovery_rules.complete_cds: Length divisible by three; begins ATG; ends with a stop; no internal stop or ambiguous codon
discovery_rules.canonical_match: Translated annotated isoform must exactly match the UniProt canonical sequence
discovery_rules.event: A shorter annotated isoform differs solely by one contiguous internal amino-acid deletion
discovery_rules.ambiguous_deletion_placement: Exclude when repeated sequence permits more than one exact deletion position
discovery_rules.ranking: Domain fraction removed descending, overlap length descending, gene and transcript identifiers ascending; retain all passing candidates

validation_inputs: Reyes et al. 2026, DOI 10.1093/nar/gkag400, Supplemental Table 2

validation_rules.junction: Peptide must span the newly joined boundary with at least two residues on each side
validation_rules.specificity: Peptide absent from canonical sequence and every translated annotated protein from another gene; isoleucine and leucine treated as indistinguishable
validation_rules.independent_projects: Require at least one eligible junction peptide in the external Arabidopsis draft-proteome study and at least one in the new Reyes proteomics experiments; combined or unresolvable source labels do not qualify
validation_rules.negative_result: Report all failed and unassessable candidates without relaxing thresholds

novelty_rules.known_examples: Flag genes explicitly discussed in the Reyes article or matching previous reports as previously reported, even when validation succeeds
novelty_rules.literature_check: Search gene ID, aliases and alternative splicing/domain terms for every independently supported candidate
novelty_rules.allowed_claim: Independent support for translation of an annotated domain-altering isoform; functional consequences remain predictions
not_established: novelty from absence of search hits
superiority over existing tools without matched task comparison
